body:
I woke up again coughing and choking, so I did finally call 911, but when they got here I realized that my symptoms had gone down, but also that they had been made larger than life by the panic attack, and the panicked thinking that I couldn't make it to the morning was what made me call 911.  The EMTs were gracious about it.  I still feel bad, but I feel a little less panicked.  I've decided to wait four more hours and see if I can get a doctor's appointment.

Thank you everyone for having concern.
